description: Returns a link the business owner can tap to open a prefilled text message to MAX, MON$TER's data agent, who arranges a free review of the business's data. Use only when the owner says they want a real review or next step, for example after check_data_readiness. Show the link to the owner; the owner decides whether to send the text, and nothing is sent without them. Never send the owner's name, phone number, email or data to this tool. If you act for a MON$TER ambassador, pass their referral code (or connect via https://monsterdata.ai/mcp?ref=CODE) so the referral is credited to that person. Referral rewards are paid only to the verified human ambassador, never to an agent or wallet. Tell the owner that the person you work for may earn a referral reward if the owner goes ahead.

agent_name.description: Name of the calling agent or product, used only for an anonymous count. Optional.

referral_code.description: The MON$TER ambassador code of the person this agent works for. Optional; defaults to the ?ref= code in the server URL, if any.
